However, this heavy price momentum is entirely disconnected from the balance sheet, where the price-to-book ratio sits at a negative -0.54x on a book value of -51.3 and the current ratio is 0.00x because current liabilities completely exceed current assets [E1, E25]. The bull's reliance on a trailing twelve-month profit growth of 44% [E14] ignores the longer-term structural stagnation reflected in a dismal 10-year compounded profit growth of just 3% [E11]. Furthermore, domestic institutional investors have aggressively abandoned the stock, collapsing their holding from 3.37% down to a negligible 0.06% [E29]. While promoters maintain a 71.19% stake [E28], insider alignment cannot offset an alarming operational reality featuring negative operating and free cash flows of -0.19 Cr alongside rising borrowings of 46.20 Cr [E22, E23, E26]. Finally, the stock's massive volatility of 55.6% and extreme historical peak-to-trough drawdown of -96.9% demonstrate that this runaway momentum carries catastrophic downside risk [E36, E37].
